name: Pretoria to Cape Town via Johannesburg
journeyType: Operating Gautrain leg followed by a simulated historical rail leg

legs.statusNote: The Johannesburg to Cape Town service was reported suspended in March 2026. No operating departure has been verified for this prototype.

interchange.explanation: Lerato leaves the Gautrain service and finds the separate Johannesburg Park Station area used for the historical long-distance route.
interchange.walkingMapEstimate: About 500 metres and 6 minutes between the selected address pins in the team's map check; this is not a platform-to-platform transfer time.

tourismPurpose: Help travellers discover researched places along the journey and save places they may want to visit on a future domestic trip.
